_about: How fast a person acts, for the slow-player bot. These are guesses, not measurements. After each action the bot waits a random time between the two thinkSeconds numbers, plus roadTileSeconds for each road tile it just laid. Now and then (pauseChance, from 0 to 1) it also stops for a longer pause, as a person does to read or look around. startSeconds is how long it looks at the island before doing anything.
